runs.code:
import json,re
p=json.load(open('envelope.json'))
levels={'trim-the-fat':(.90,.95),'less-wordy':(.70,.70),'more-concise':(.60,.60),'more-succinct':(.40,.50),'shorten-markdown-changes-quotes':(.70,.70)}
def words(s):
 return [w for w in s.split() if not re.fullmatch(r'[`~*_#|>\-]+',w)]
out=[]
for c in p['cases']:
 if c['id'] not in levels: continue
 prompt=c['prompt'][len(p['runner_context'].rstrip()):].lstrip('\n')
 source=prompt.split('Source:\n',1)[1] if 'Source:\n' in prompt else prompt.split(': ',1)[1]
 n=len(words(source)); lo,hi=levels[c['id']]
 out.append(dict(id=c['id'],source=source,original_words=n,budget=[round(n*lo),round(n*hi)],ratios=[lo,hi]))
print(json.dumps(out,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
